t: You're standing where The Great House in Leyton once stood. It was an English country house, but it has been demolished, so nothing of the building remains for you to see. One of its owners was Thomas Oliver of Mark Lane, a London merchant who traded with the West Indies. His ownership shows the house belonged to the world of City trade, in the days when merchants kept grand homes outside the capital. I don't have more detail on the house or its dates, so I'll leave the rest to your imagination.
